items.headline: Mestemaker and Hawkins lead Oklahoma State's dominant effort over Kansas State 66-28
items.description: — Drew Mestemaker became the first Bowl Subdivision player with four touchdown passes, one rushing touchdown and one receiving touchdown since Virginia’s Brennan Armstrong against BYU in 2021 as Oklahoma State trounced Kansas State 66-28 on Saturday.
